title: Record retention
purpose: Read the laboratory’s recorded statement about electronic record retention and the reasons for changes.
summary: Your laboratory's own statement about how long electronic records are kept, and the history of changes to it.

tasks.title: Read the statement
steps: Read the Retention statement. Not recorded means none has been entered yet.

tasks.title: Change the statement
steps: Select [[Edit in administration]]. Only a superuser with the admin role sees it.
Give a reason for the change. It is kept in the history.

good_to_know: Electronic records are never deleted automatically.
This statement does not set how long physical samples are kept. That is managed under Sample storage.
The statement is your laboratory's policy text, not a compliance certification.

items.label: Retention statement
items.description: Laboratory-written text, separate from physical sample retention. “Not recorded” means no statement has been entered; “No laboratory configured” means setup is incomplete.

items.label: Laboratory name
items.description: The configured organization whose statement is displayed.

items.label: History
items.description: The latest 20 statement-change audit events, presented in chronological order within that window.

items.label: Statement changed / Recorded by / time / reason
items.description: Identifies each change, its actor, timestamp and reason. It is attributed history, not an editable policy record.

items.label: Edit in administration
items.description: Available only to a staff superuser who also holds the admin laboratory role. Opens the lab retention form; changes and clearing the statement require a reason and a current revision.

items.label: Physical sample retention
items.description: Managed separately under Sample storage. This statement neither calculates a sample retain-through date nor schedules deletion.

items.label: No automatic purge
items.description: Electronic records are not automatically deleted. A recorded statement is the laboratory’s policy text, not a compliance certification.
